questions.question: Whom did the king of Babylon appoint as governor over Judah in chapter 40?
What advice did Gedaliah give the people?
options: To take up the sword at once and drive the Babylonians from the land
To flee away in haste across the river into the distant land of Egypt
To scatter abroad and seek what shelter they could among the nations
To serve the king of Babylon, dwell in the land, and it would go well
questions.answer: To serve the king of Babylon, dwell in the land, and it would go well
